summary.note: 17 'partial' screens are mostly modals/panels/sections that hold real capability but are not routes. Plan Gate 1 requires a production route and a direct-navigation test per screen; promoting a working modal to a route is cheap. This is where the programme's best effort-to-value ratio sits.
summary.accessibility: PHASE 15: axe-core WCAG 2.2 A/AA + best-practice clean on 34 screens in light and dark; 16 screens fit 1280/1024/768/430/390 with no sideways scroll and 24px tap targets on phones; skip link, visible focus, dialog focus/Escape, keyboard exam, reduced motion under test
summary.states: PHASE 16: every screen opened with the server gone and with slow responses. Unread data is never shown as empty, zero or 'to do'; failures say what, why and that nothing changed, with Retry; 25 labelled loading states; a connection banner on every screen; System Design answers and mock answers kept on the device and sent when the server returns, with the plan's five save states
summary.performance: PHASE 17: timed against a heavy install (5,000 questions, 20,000 answers, 400 sessions, 400-topic roadmap, 500 analysed recordings). Starting a mock 6.3s->0.15s, review queue 3.0s->0.06s, storage 5.7s->0.02s, checking a 2,000-row import 57s->0.7s, saving one 45s->1.4s, recordings list 51 queries->2. Production build: shell 0.66s, route change 0.13s, 2,000-question bank 1.1s, 300-topic roadmap 2.0s
summary.security: PHASE 17: single-user local app (no auth by decision). Audited and tested: upload type/size, path handling (recordings cannot name a file outside their folder), XSS, SQL injection, prompt injection (six prompts fence submitted text), secret handling (reference only, never returned). Preparation isolation covers what object-level authorization would in a multi-user app
summary.upgrade_path: PHASE 17: scripts/upgrade_check.py upgrades a read-only copy of the real database and compares it with a fresh one: 0 schema differences, no row loss, integrity and foreign keys clean, no orphans, endpoints serve, original unchanged. Migrations now create every non-unique index the models declare (an upgraded install was missing six)
summary.parity: PARITY Pass 1 & Pass 2 complete: the prototype's shell, visual tokens, responsive viewports, and screens matched against PrepBench_Unified_Prototype.html. Header: section and preparation breadcrumb, Search, Alerts, Import, Settings, theme, profile avatar. Sidebar: the prototype's five groups and fourteen destinations with its labels (Roadmaps added), Settings inside Workspace, Review Queue count. Screens: search, profile, roadmap-editor, roadmaps list. 0 missing; the 6 partial screens are the documented modal/panel/tab deviations. Responsive: 1280, 1024, 768, 430, 390 all pass with 0px overflow; touch targets WCAG 2.2 compliant. Performance: question bank summary optimized from 455ms to 47.4ms; all 34 benchmarks in perf_gate.py pass. Full test suite: backend 757 passed, unit 765 passed (69 files), browser 70 passed. See PARITY-REPORT.md.
